title: Literary Design of Matthew 5:3-12
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 5:3-12</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group title="Social Status" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="3" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">How good is life for</char> the powerless, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> theirs is <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">the kingdom of</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">the skies</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="4" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">How good is life for</char> those who grieve, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> they will be comforted. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="5" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">How good is life for</char> the unimportant, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> they will inherit <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">the land</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group title="Character" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="6" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">How good is life for</char> those who hunger and thirst for <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">righteousness</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> they will be satisfied. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="7" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">How good is life for</char> those who show mercy, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> they will be shown mercy. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="8" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">How good is life for</char> the pure in heart, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> they will see God. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group title="Conduct" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="9" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">How good is life for</char> the peacemakers, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> they will be called children of God. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="10" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">How good is life for</char> those who have been <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">persecuted</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        on account of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">righteousness</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> theirs is <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">the kingdom of</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">the skies</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="11" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">How good is life for</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">you all</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        when they insult <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">you</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">persecute you</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and speak any evil lies against <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">you</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        on account of me. 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="12" /> Celebrate and shout for joy, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">your</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">reward</char> is great <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">in</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">the skies</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because</char> this is how they <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">persecuted</char> the prophets before <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">you all</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group>
      
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
